digest.component_or_area: Terraform drift detection and Gerrit CI gating
propositions: terraform-drift.yml only triggers on pull_request, push to main, or schedule—never on Gerrit changes, so drift checks run post-merge rather than pre-submit
Gerrit changes can be submitted with Verified +1 despite containing unapplied terraform resources because the drift gate does not execute before landing
the manual terraform apply step is decoupled from the submit process, leaving committed-but-unapplied HCL as an invisible failure mode that reddens main after the change is already merged

a change adding a terraform resource (like aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm.review_interrupts in commit e9d4d390c3) passed all gates and was submitted despite terraform plan reporting a pending add, proving the workflow did not run pre-submit
